development_preparation_boundary.known_exposure_policy: Exclude confirmed old case and published vignette/source families for a proposed new development sample; mapping overlap alone is not confirmed evaluation exposure.
development_preparation_boundary.unknown_published_roster: Disclose and retain; prevents strong freshness claims but not explicitly development-only source qualification.
development_preparation_boundary.next_finite_step: Prospectively specify up to two development-only source-question contexts, at most three articles and six intact excerpts/1500 words each; qualify original snippets/locators/context/date/rights without repairing outputs or inventing hypotheses.
